privacy.body: Unlike online tools that upload your video files to a remote cloud server, our MP4 to JPG converter leverages HTML5 Web APIs to decode videos directly inside your web browser. Your video is parsed locally and the images are saved in your browser environment. Your files are never transmitted across the network, keeping your sensitive or proprietary footage completely secure.

steps.title: Choose Your MP4
steps.body: Drag and drop your MP4 file into the upload zone above.

steps.title: Configure Output Frame Rate (FPS)
steps.body: Choose your extraction frequency. Select 30 FPS to grab 30 frames per second of video, or choose 1 FPS to extract one frame per second.

steps.title: Select Format
steps.body: Ensure "JPG" is selected as the output format.

steps.title: Extract Frames

steps.title: Save Output

items.q: How do I convert an MP4 video to JPG images for free?
items.a: Simply drag and drop your MP4 file into the tool, select JPG format, choose your FPS, and click Extract. All frames are processed locally in your browser and will download as a ZIP file. No account or server upload needed.

items.q: Is there a file size limit for MP4 to JPG conversion?
items.a: No server upload required. Processing happens in your browser, so large files depend on your device memory, browser performance, video length, and codec support.

items.q: How many JPG frames will I get from my MP4?
items.a: It depends on your video duration and chosen FPS (Frames Per Second) setting. For example, a 10-second video converted at 10 FPS will extract approximately 100 JPG images.

items.q: Can I convert MP4 to PNG instead of JPG?
items.a: Yes. Use the format selector inside the tool to switch to PNG output if you need lossless quality frames.

items.q: Does MP4 to JPG conversion work on mobile devices?
items.a: Yes. Our tool runs directly in modern mobile web browsers like Safari on iOS and Chrome on Android, though performance depends on the device's hardware capability.
